# Australia JavaScript engine update ledger

This ledger is the row-for-row package disposition of ServiceNow's [Australia JavaScript engine update table](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/api-reference/scripts/updates-javascript-engine.html). It distinguishes implemented diagnostics, deliberately metadata-only behavior, and unfinished investigation. A listed row does not imply that every runtime behavior can or should produce a lint diagnostic.

- Official release label: Australia
- Official page updated: 2026-03-12
- Package review: 2026-08-24
- Official rows: 19
- Diagnostic coverage: 10
- Metadata only: 1
- Pending: 8
- Audit complete: no

Pending means the package has not yet established a safe final disposition. Unknown or ambiguous behavior remains silent; it is never counted as supported merely because the row appears here.

## Pending investigations

- [#1905](https://github.com/mozilla/rhino/pull/1905) — **Support ArrayBuffer detachment:** A useful diagnostic must first prove a detachment source and a later affected buffer, typed-array, or DataView operation without assuming unavailable host APIs.
- [#1751](https://github.com/mozilla/rhino/pull/1751), [#1872](https://github.com/mozilla/rhino/pull/1872) — **Support Symbol.hasInstance on Function.prototype:** The review must separate explicit Function.prototype[Symbol.hasInstance] use from ordinary instanceof behavior and prove Symbol/Function authority.
- [#1870](https://github.com/mozilla/rhino/pull/1870) — **Rework String.prototype.search, replace, replaceAll, and split:** The upstream change spans RegExp protocol dispatch and edge-case result semantics; actionable pre-Australia patterns require case-by-case proof.
- [#2073](https://github.com/mozilla/rhino/pull/2073), [#2107](https://github.com/mozilla/rhino/pull/2107) — **Support duplicate keys in object literals:** Release-specific parser behavior must be reconciled with Oxlint and ESLint core duplicate-key diagnostics before adding overlapping guidance.
- [#2097](https://github.com/mozilla/rhino/pull/2097) — **Calling eval of a function returns undefined:** A diagnostic needs a static eval source, direct-eval authority, and proof that the release-dependent completion value is observed.
- [#2065](https://github.com/mozilla/rhino/pull/2065) — **Correct template literal to string conversion:** Object-to-primitive conversion can execute user code; a rule requires narrow provenance and side-effect proof to avoid speculative diagnostics.
- [#2060](https://github.com/mozilla/rhino/pull/2060) — **Don't propagate strict mode when compiling scripts:** The affected dynamic compilation entrypoints and observable strictness dependency must be proven before source-level guidance is safe.
- [#1945](https://github.com/mozilla/rhino/pull/1945) — **Correct this in require:** A rule needs reliable identification of ServiceNow module source and a proven observable top-level this dependency.

## Maintenance contract

<code>src/engine/australia-updates.ts</code> is authoritative. Tests pin the official row and pull-request inventory, reject duplicate identities, and verify that completed diagnostic/metadata entries reference real engine capabilities. Run <code>npm run docs</code> after changing a disposition.
